requirements.text: Public API MUST enforce strict schemas and fail closed.
TrustSpaceID and ContextID MUST be derived from canonical Genesis material.
Every accepted transition MUST be atomic and followed by whole-state validation.
Active Authority scopes for one Context/capability MUST NOT overlap.
PermitTerms MUST bind readiness and issue Decision.
Permit success predicate MUST resolve in active Constitution rules.
Verification policy MUST equal Permit success predicate.
Outcome MUST aggregate the complete effective PASS Verification set.
Correction MUST target only non-final Verification.
Causal parents MUST be derived from typed artifact references.
Ordinary transitions MUST fail in SUSPENDED Context.
Known local commits MUST be complete and fork evidence preserved.
NORMATIVE dependency endpoints MUST be ACTIVE.
Standalone withdrawal MUST be member-signed and MUST NOT break an active normative dependant.
AffectedSiblingSet MUST be computed transitively from pre-state.
Proposal digest MUST bind the full embedded proposal.
Every affected member MUST authorize the exact proposal.
Parent MUST hold REDEFINE_CONTEXT Authority.
Redefinition MUST commit atomically or leave State unchanged.
Successors MUST preserve parent, alias, member and kind while receiving new ContextID.
Dependencies among affected siblings MUST remap to successors.
Governance records MUST retain full proposal and proof digests.
Authority transfer MUST use a same-context positive action trail and new-holder readiness.
Reference runtime branch coverage MUST be at least 90 percent for freeze.
Coverage and publication QA MUST be bound to exact source/document bytes.
Freeze requires clean-room validation of the deterministic archive.
